summary: Platform-and-cabin lookout on Saddle Mountain, Tillamook County, OR, erected 1922 and gone by 1953; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Register says the platform and cabin were removed in 1953; firelookout.com says destroyed that year

events.note: Platform and cabin erected on the site (both listings)
Register says removed; firelookout.com says destroyed
Registered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register, November 15, 2010

evidence.supports: platform and cabin erected in 1922; removed in 1953
evidence.quote: In 1922 a platform and cabin were erected on this site, which were removed in 1953.

evidence.supports: same summit: Tillamook County and Tillamook FPA named on the firelookout.com listing

notes_for_editor: Only two short listings exist for this summit, and they agree on 1922 and 1953 but differ on removed vs destroyed. No staffing, fire or present-day source was found, so the story says nothing about those. Do not mix in the Saddle Mountain (South) page on oregonlookouts.weebly.com or firelookout.com/or/saddlesouth.html: they describe South Saddle Mountain (US 733, Washington County, 45.548, -123.375), where a 1932 log house burned in the 1933 Wilson River fire. The Clatsop County Saddle Mountain (North Saddle) and the Pend Oreille County Saddle Mountain are different summits too. A search snippet from theroamingcivic.com ties a 1953 lookout to the Clatsop summit, so the 1953 date here should be re-checked against any new source before publication. Checked 2026-10-10: the firelookout.com listing also gives Tillamook County, Tillamook FPA and 3475 ft, so both listings describe the Tillamook summit and the 1953 date stands on both.
